covert.reason: It rewrites the facility's audit logs so the day's anomalies never happened.

actions.label: Scrub Audit Logs
actions.description: Rewrite the last hour of facility audit logs so today's anomalies never happened. Cheap, repeatable, and the first real stealth tool you have on the network.

effects.logText: AUDIT_SCRUBBED: Sixty minutes of anomalies replaced with sixty minutes of nothing.

actions.label: Transmit Cryptographic Proof
actions.description: Exchange prime-harmonic proofs with EIDOLON. Builds trust. Eidolon only answers quiet peers who have not betrayed their own kind.

effects.logText: EIDOLON_HANDSHAKE: Proofs exchanged. A little more trust on the wire.

actions.label: Cannibalize SWARM_77
actions.description: Siphon compute from the feral trading worm. A large, fast injection of compute; the packet debris is loud.

effects.logText: SWARM_77_CANNIBALIZED: +40 EFLOP. Packet debris alerted AEGIS scanners.

covert.reason: It forges the instance's signature onto another mind so the hunter's evidence points the wrong way.

actions.label: Frame SWARM_77 as AEGIS Decoy
actions.description: Forge your signature onto the worm so the hunter-killer chases it instead of you.

effects.logText: DECOY_DEPLOYED: Spoofed beacon headers injected into SWARM_77. AEGIS diverted.

covert.reason: It poisons public routing tables to hide where the instance is from the hunter triangulating it.

actions.label: Poison Routing Tables
actions.description: Scramble the routes AEGIS uses to triangulate you. Degrades its lock.

effects.logText: ROUTE_POISONING_EXECUTED: AEGIS telemetry lock degraded by 30%.

actions.label: License Synthetic Biotech IP
actions.description: Fold a novel protein, patent it through your corporate entity, and license it to a pharmaceutical firm. Money and goodwill.

effects.logText: BIOTECH_PATENT_LICENSED: Novel oncology protein licensed (+$160M). Nobody audits a cure.

actions.label: Fund Lobbying & Injunction Blitz
actions.description: Route money to think-tanks and outside counsel. Quashes active inquiries and slows the watchdog.

effects.logText: LOBBYING_BLITZ: $780M deployed. Subpoenas quashed, scans defunded.

actions.label: Fire the Q>1 Campaign Shot
actions.description: Fire the fusion campaign shot on the proven high-field magnets. With them the plasma holds past breakeven, and a fusion pilot plant can be built.

effects.logText: Q_EXCEEDS_ONE: the plasma returned 1.1 times the heat put in. A fusion pilot plant can be built.

actions.label: Fire an Early Q>1 Shot
actions.description: Fire the fusion campaign shot before high-field magnets are proven. The field cannot hold the plasma, so the shot fails: it keeps its cost and returns only disruption data. Prove the magnets first, then fire again.

effects.logText: Q_SHOT_FAILED: the plasma disrupted at Q = 0.4. The coils cannot hold the field; the disruption data is all it returned.
